module_summary: supportbase.cpp is the shared game-source backend used by every device leg (BDM, MMCE, SMB/NFS, UDPFS, HDD, HTTP): CD/DVD ISO directory scan with the games.bin cache and folder-browse rows, ul.cfg read/rebuild, game path composition, delete/rename, per-game config population (size stat, PS1 keying, disc badges), CDVDMAN patch-zone preparation (compat modes, PADEMU/OSD settings, IGR USB driver write to the memory card), cheat/cheat-image loading, Neutrino install resolution and launch-argument handling, custom loader path alias resolution, and in RetroAchievements builds the watch-list/hunt loading, the RA hash log and the deferred hash workers. udpfssupport.h is the public header of the UDPFS backend; it also carries that backend's private list-cache class and VMC struct and is included by about 25 translation units.

reusable_helpers.name: sbMakeDirTree
reusable_helpers.what: mkdir -p for a device path, accepting / or \ separators after the device colon

reusable_helpers.name: sbJoinDeviceTail
reusable_helpers.what: joins a device root and a tail with exactly one separator, bounded (static)

reusable_helpers.name: sbPathToken
reusable_helpers.what: lower-cased device token before ':' plus the tail pointer (static)

reusable_helpers.name: sbFillArg
reusable_helpers.what: substitutes one argument at the first %s of a translated string without using it as a format (static)

reusable_helpers.name: sbFileSizeMB
reusable_helpers.what: file size in MiB via stat with an lseek64 fallback (static)

reusable_helpers.name: sbRebuildULCfg
reusable_helpers.what: staged write to <file>.new then rename over the original, with fallbacks

reusable_helpers.name: sbCreateSemaphore
reusable_helpers.what: creates a binary EE semaphore (init 1, max 1)

reusable_helpers.name: naAppend
reusable_helpers.what: appends a space-separated token to a bounded string (static)

reusable_helpers.name: sbCreatePath
reusable_helpers.what: composes the on-device path of a game part for every game format, honouring the folder-browse subpath

findings.title: SupportBase class and include/supportbaseint.h are a single-instance wrapper used only by supportbase.cpp, reached through thin forwarders
findings.problem: The class holds three values (the size-stat owner thread, the IGR-USB asked latch, the RA hash-log FILE*), has one instance gSupportBase, and every member is reached only through a free forwarder in the same file (sbEnsureIgrUsbDrivers, sbSetConfigStatSize, sbConfigStatSizeEnabled, raHashLogOpen/Step/Add/Close). Nothing outside supportbase.cpp includes supportbaseint.h or names gSupportBase.
findings.fix: Delete include/supportbaseint.h and the class. Make the three fields file-scope statics in supportbase.cpp, move each member body into its free function, and delete the forwarders and the gSupportBase instance. Update the stub in .github/scripts/test_info_size_ps1.py (lines 52, 112-113), which matches the SupportBase:: signatures.
findings.benefit: ~70 lines removed (43-line header, 6 forwarders of 4 lines, the instance and its comment); ELF effect negligible (INFERRED: same-TU forwarders, one small global object replaced by statics).
findings.evidence: Grep gSupportBase|supportbaseint.h|SupportBase:: over src/RiptOPL (docs excluded): only supportbase.cpp:11,63,932,935,1303,1308,1315,1320,1349,1459,2831-2887, supportbaseint.h:40, and test_info_size_ps1.py:52,112-113. Free entry points are the API in include/supportbase.h; ensureIgrUsbDrivers referenced only in supportbaseint.h and supportbase.cpp.

findings.title: sbPopulateConfigIn re-implements sbCreatePath_name's path composition for its size stat (and differs from it)
findings.problem: The size-stat block rebuilds the subseg string (1453-1457, identical to 1218-1222) and the ISO, OLD_ISO and USBLD part paths (1462-1479) that sbCreatePath_name already composes. The copy inserts an extra separator after the prefix ("%s%s%s..." prefix, sep, CD/DVD at 1463/1467) where sbCreatePath does not, so the stat path is e.g. udpfs://CD/x.iso while the launch path is udpfs:/CD/x.iso.
findings.fix: Replace 1453-1480 with one loop over the game's parts that calls sbCreatePath(game, gamepath, prefix, sep, part) and adds sbFileSizeMB(gamepath); keep the isPs1/sizeMB/gate condition.
findings.benefit: ~18 lines removed and one path rule instead of two (INFERRED: 31-line block becomes ~10 lines).
findings.evidence: Read supportbase.cpp:1210-1243 and 1450-1481. Callers pass the same prefix/sep pairs to sbCreatePath and sbPopulateConfig(In): udpfssupport.cpp:939/1199 (udpfsPrefix, "/"), mmcesupport.cpp:1487/1754, ethsupport.cpp:1243/1553 ("\\"), bdmsupport.cpp:2069 + bdmlaunch.cpp:815. udpfsPrefix comment 'udpfs:/' at udpfssupport.cpp:50; bdmBuildGamePrefix bdmsupport.cpp:223-229 ends with '/'. INFERRED: that drivers currently tolerate the doubled separator (upstream OPL has the same extra sep); not tested on hardware.

findings.title: sbResolveCustomLoaderPath: mc/mmce alias blocks and pfs/rom literal-or-unit-0 blocks are near-copies
findings.problem: The mc and mmce blocks (21 and 22 lines) are the same two-slot probe, differing only in the stem length (2 vs 4), the root format and the mmceLoadModules() call. The pfs and rom tails (10 lines each) are identical except for the unit-0 root string.
findings.fix: Fold mc/mmce into one static helper taking the stem length and root format (call mmceLoadModules before it for mmce), and pfs/rom into one helper taking the unit-0 root.
findings.benefit: ~25 lines removed net (INFERRED: 43+20 duplicated lines become two helpers of ~20+8 lines plus 4 call lines).
findings.evidence: Read supportbase.cpp:2235-2482 in full; compared 2262-2282 with 2285-2306 line by line and 2366-2375 with 2431-2440.

findings.title: Three copies of the four Neutrino folder/file case variants
findings.problem: sbNeutrinoProbeGameDevice ("%sNEUTRINO/neutrino.elf" etc.), sbResolveMigratedApaNeutrino (relative names) and sbProbeNeutrinoMc (8 absolute mc0/mc1 strings, mixing "mc0:NEUTRINO/" from NEUTRINO_PATH with "mc0:/neutrino/") each spell out the same four case combinations, in three different orders.
findings.fix: Keep one static table of the four relative names; build the game-device and mc0:/mc1: candidates from it with snprintf in the existing loops.
findings.benefit: ~10 lines removed (INFERRED: 18 table lines become 6 plus a format call); one probe order everywhere.
findings.evidence: Read the three tables; NEUTRINO_PATH/NEUTRINO_ALT_PATH are "mc0:NEUTRINO/neutrino.elf"/"mc1:NEUTRINO/neutrino.elf" (include/system.h:31-32). Grep NEUTRINO/NEUTRINO.ELF over the repo: only these tables, no test pins them.

findings.title: updateISOGameList: redundant change-detection branches and an unreachable 'Last game deleted' branch
findings.problem: modified can only become 1 when head != NULL && count > 0 (both branches at 240 and 261), so the test at 270 is always true and the remove() at 295-298 never runs; 257-259 re-assigns 0. In scanForISO, passing &cache when no cache loaded gives the same decision as NULL (count 0), and freeISOGameListCache is a no-op on the empty cache, so 482-483 and 487-492 need no cacheLoaded branches. Upstream-derived (Open PS2 Loader).
findings.fix: Compute modified as (head && count > 0) && (cache == NULL || count != cache->count || mismatch); delete the else at 257-259, the condition at 270 and the dead else at 295-298; in scanForISO call updateISOGameList(path, &cache, ...) and freeISOGameListCache unconditionally.
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed (READ: 3 + 4 + 2 + ~5 from the collapsed branches); no behaviour change, since the removed branch is unreachable today.
findings.evidence: Read supportbase.cpp:168-301 and 361-495. loadISOGameListCache frees first (175) and leaves {0,NULL} on any failure; freeISOGameListCache checks games != NULL (216). test_iso_cache.py compiles updateISOGameList and checks only its rewrite decision, which the simplification keeps; test_bdm_scan_retry.py:475 stubs it.

findings.title: Commented-out USBLD size calculation and TODO in sbReadList, superseded by sbPopulateConfigIn
findings.problem: A 12-line block-commented loop computing USBLD part sizes, with a TODO calling it slow. The same per-part size is now computed on demand in sbPopulateConfigIn (1470-1479), behind the size-stat gate.
findings.evidence: Read 650-665 and 1470-1479; the commented code is the same loop (USBA_crc32 name checksum, ul.%08X.%s.%02x part names, size >> 20).

findings.title: sbNeutrinoDeinitException only forwards to sbLoaderDeinitException
findings.problem: The function body is return sbLoaderDeinitException(neutrinoPath); the header calls it a backward-compatible wrapper. Its 7 callers (bdmlaunch.cpp:499, ethsupport.cpp:1275, hddsupport.cpp:2443,2453,2502, mmcesupport.cpp:1675, udpfssupport.cpp:1186) can call sbLoaderDeinitException directly, as the VCD legs already do.
findings.fix: Replace the 7 calls with sbLoaderDeinitException and delete the wrapper and its prototype; update the string match in .github/scripts/test_handoff_probe.py:74.
findings.benefit: 6 lines removed (READ); no ELF change worth stating.
findings.evidence: Grep sbNeutrinoDeinitException over the repo (docs excluded): definition 2085, prototype supportbase.h:131, the 7 callers listed, and test_handoff_probe.py:74. sbLoaderDeinitException already called directly at bdmlaunch.cpp:251, ethsupport.cpp:1043, mmcesupport.cpp:1285, hddsupport.cpp:2299, udpfssupport.cpp:824.

findings.title: RA hash workers repeat the log open/close pair on every exit; the two deferred entry points repeat the queue tail
findings.problem: sbHashGame and sbHashHdlGame both start with raHashLogOpen(path); raHashSetStepLog(&raHashStep) and end every return path with raHashSetStepLog(NULL); raHashLogClose() (5 copies). Both run only from sbHashGameDeferredWorker. sbHashGameDeferred and sbHashHdlDeferred end with the same 5-line ioPutRequest/busy-reset tail.
findings.fix: Open the log and set the step hook once in sbHashGameDeferredWorker before dispatch and clear/close once after; drop the pairs from the two workers. Share the queue tail in one small static function.
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed (READ: 7 pairs = 14 lines, plus ~4 from the shared tail, minus ~4 added).
findings.evidence: Read 2935-3146. Grep sbHashGame\b over .github/scripts: test_ra_disc.py:334 stubs sbHashGame by signature only. sbHashHdlGame and sbHashGame have no caller except sbHashGameDeferredWorker (3142, 3144).

findings.title: Small redundant statements in supportbase.cpp (duplicate includes, impossible conditions, repeated assignments)
findings.problem: cheatman.h and gui.h are included twice (19/29, 15/31). In isValidIsoName the else-if (size >= 5) is always true after the guard at 99. In sbReadList count is forced >= 0 at 590-591, so 602-603 and the count > 0 ? count : 0 at 619/677 are no-ops and count = 0 at 693 is a dead store. result = -1 is set twice (797, 800). fakemodule_flags takes three statements for one value. The else-if test at 1493 repeats the negation of 1486. sbGetCheatSearchLog returns a static array that cannot be NULL. vmcArgs->arg[slot][0] is already cleared at 2673 before 2702.
findings.fix: Delete the second includes, the always-true and repeated tests, the dead store and the duplicate assignments; set fakemodule_flags in one statement; read cheatSearchLog directly in sbCheatsNotFoundText and delete sbGetCheatSearchLog.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed (READ, counted from the cited lines); no ELF change (the compiler already folds these).
findings.evidence: Read every cited line and its context. Grep sbGetCheatSearchLog over the repo: definition 1644 and the single use 1657 only. test_patch_zone_restore.py:89 stubs sbCheatsNotFoundText, not the accessor. No test pins fakemodule_flags in supportbase.cpp (test_udpfs_files_oplcore.py:93-94 match udpfssupport.cpp lines).

findings.title: Stale and displaced comments in supportbase.cpp
findings.problem: 45-46 is a history note on a forward declaration that is only needed because sbFileExists is defined at 2111. 1498-1503 narrates the old single-caller state (hddsupport.c). The sbCheatsMissingContinue doc block (1606-1624) sits above CHT_TAR_MEMBER_MAX and the search-log code, 40 lines from its function, and its NOTE(rebuild) says the search log is still to come though 1627-1665 already append it. 1757 names src/tar.c (the file is src/platform/tar.cpp). The sbNeutrinoInstallComplete comment (1948-1954) sits above sbLastPathSeparator. 2548-2550 says the resolver probes mc0/mc1 for the bdm + mmce paths; it now runs custom -> game device -> mc for five backends.
findings.fix: Move sbFileExists above its first use and delete the forward declaration and its note; delete the NOTE(rebuild) paragraph and the historical narration; move the two displaced comments onto their functions; correct the tar file name and the resolver description in a line each.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed (READ: 2 + 4 + 3 + ~6 of narration); comments then match the code.
findings.evidence: Read all cited comments with their code. Glob src/**/tar.*: only src/platform/tar.cpp and include/tar.h. Grep sbResolveNeutrinoPath( in src: bdmlaunch, ethsupport, hddsupport, mmcesupport, udpfssupport plus the definition.

findings.title: udpfssupport.h exposes the UDPFS backend's private cache class, VMC struct and mcemu.h to about 25 includers
findings.problem: udpfs_vmc_infos_t, class UdpfsSupport, the UdpfsSource forward declaration, extern gUdpfsSupport and UDPFS_MODE_UPDATE_DELAY are used in src/ only by udpfssupport.cpp, yet the header (and with it include/mcemu.h and <time.h>) is included by about 25 files, most of which want only udpfsGetModulesLoaded.
findings.fix: Move those declarations and the mcemu.h/<time.h> includes into udpfssupport.cpp, leaving the header with the five function prototypes and udpfsShowPendingNotice; update the header regexes in test_udpfs_files_oplcore.py:203 and the tests that read the header.
findings.benefit: ~4 lines removed net (extern, forward declaration, two includes); smaller public interface and fewer recompiles. No ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep gUdpfsSupport|UdpfsSupport|udpfs_vmc_infos_t in src/: only udpfssupport.cpp (878-881, 908, 1019, 1023) and the header; none in mmcesupport.cpp. UDPFS_MODE_UPDATE_DELAY used at udpfssupport.cpp:224,313 (tests define their own copy). Grep udpfssupport.h in src: 25 includers.
